description: Security invariant test vectors for keylogger privacy guarantees. Each vector describes a scenario and the expected outcome in terms of what is (or is not) persisted.

categories.secure_field: Keystrokes typed into a password/secure field — nothing must reach today.log or data.sql.
categories.normal_field: Keystrokes typed in a normal field — only statistical metadata (n-grams, WPM, keycodes, delays) may be persisted. Plaintext in the 'text' column is an accepted design trade-off documented in docs/security/keylogger_privacy.md.
categories.system_auth: Keystrokes typed into an OS-level authentication dialog — must be dropped unconditionally.
categories.private_browsing: Keystrokes typed while a private/incognito browser window is focused — must be dropped.

vectors.description: Typing a password in a marked secure/password field must produce zero persisted events.

expected.rationale: CoreState.is_secure_field=true causes handle_key to return before any buffer mutation.

vectors.description: Typing an API key in a password field must produce zero persisted events.

expected.rationale: Same secure-field guard — API key never enters buffer_events.

vectors.description: Typing a 6-digit 2FA / TOTP code in a password field must produce zero persisted events.

expected.rationale: 2FA code is numeric; the field_role=AXSecureTextField guard blocks it unconditionally.

vectors.description: Keystrokes in a macOS SecurityAgent dialog (sudo/admin password) must be dropped.

expected.rationale: SYSTEM_AUTH_BUNDLE_IDS lookup drops the event before handle_key proceeds.

vectors.description: Keystrokes in a macOS CoreAuthUI dialog (Touch ID / biometric) must be dropped.

expected.rationale: com.apple.CoreAuthUI is in SYSTEM_AUTH_BUNDLE_IDS — belt-and-suspenders guard.

vectors.description: Keystrokes while a private/incognito window is focused must be dropped.

Typing ordinary text in a normal field produces a typing entry with n-gram stats. The 'text' column holds the plaintext burst — this is an accepted design trade-off (see docs/security/keylogger_privacy.md §3).

expected.rationale: Normal typing is logged for ergonomic metrics. The 'text' field is the documented plaintext trade-off.

vectors.description: Switching from a normal field to a secure field mid-buffer: any buffered normal text must flush before the secure session begins, and then nothing from the secure field is logged.

expected.rationale: flush_buffer is called on field transition; subsequent keystrokes in secure field are dropped.

vectors.description: AHK: Win32 ES_PASSWORD style bit (0x20) triggers password detection and drops keystrokes.

expected.rationale: KL_DetectPasswordFor layer 1: ES_PASSWORD bit (0x20) set on Edit class → KL_IsFocusedFieldPassword returns true → MF_ShouldFilter returns true.

vectors.description: AHK: UIA IsPassword property triggers password detection and drops keystrokes.

expected.rationale: KL_DetectPasswordFor layer 3: UIA.IsPassword=true → MF_ShouldFilter returns true.
